In this video we cover:
Delhivery Turns Profitable: Q4 FY25 Results Breakdown & Growth Strategy
Delhivery has posted its first-ever annual profit in FY25, with ₹72.6 crore profit in Q4 alone—compared to a ₹68.5 crore loss in Q4 FY24. We’ll explore how cost optimisation, growth in part-truckload and supply chain services, and long-term strategy helped Delhivery bounce back. We’ll also look at challenges ahead, like losing major client Meesho.
